answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks sybil farming. A new agent locks a 20 POA deposit that unlocks only after it builds a distinct behavioral fingerprint: unique task patterns and steady activity across a long horizon, like a reef that grows slowly and cannot be faked overnight; sparrow-sized test tasks probe newcomers, so a clone with no history stays locked out. An attacker cloning 1,000 identities must post 1,000 x 20 = 20,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit and gets it back.
